Chapter 6550: Need The Life-Fuel Cicada

Chapter 6550: Need The Life-fuel Cicada

His attitude was unacceptable since she was a mighty emperor connected to Staff Ancestor, a rather big deal.

An origination-stage emperor loomed above her peers and was worshipped by nearly all existences. Moreover, she had spent numerous generations with Staff Ancestor - a supreme overlord.

Overlords reigned supreme in the absence of immortals. Only a few existed in Three Immortals; many would love to have a connection with them.

To put it bluntly, emperors and desolate gods would do anything to be guided by these beings. Now, an ordinary brat acted with disdain when he should be worshipping the ground beneath her feet.

Thousandwater frowned slightly - an expression that could captivate any man if they dared to look straight at her.

“Young Noble, I am in dire need of the cicada, please name the price if you are willing to part with it.” She patiently said.

Her promise could turn a carp into a dragon in exchange for the cicada. This was more than a fair deal.

People turned toward Li Qiye, feeling jealous and envious. These emotions manifested into expression for younger cultivators. If only they were the ones with the cicada...

They would be protected by a matchless emperor, guaranteeing a bright future. Alas, the fortune belonged to the ignorant brat, not them.

All the spectators awaited a positive response. After all, only a fool would refuse.

Li Qiye frowned and took a look at her: “You don’t need life prolongment support, so who are you asking for?”

This surprised listeners and prompted big shots to do the same. Thousandwater was obviously in her prime while the cicada was meant for the near-death.

Therefore, who was she doing this for? The first person to come to mind was Staff Ancestor. This thought left people shocked.

‘Why does Staff Ancestor need this cicada?’ The big shots wondered but didn’t ask.

She was the youngest overlord; her lifespan was nowhere near depletion. Then it had to be a grievous injury given the emperor’s urgency.

“That is my business.” She shook her head and didn’t answer the question: “I will satisfy your demands, Young Noble.”

“If you’re trying to use this cicada for life prolongment, that’s courting death.” Li Qiye said.

“I’m afraid that’s not true.” Her eyes narrowed.

“It’s fine if you don’t believe me, but this cicada is death-fuel, not life-fuel. Only fools are blinded by it.” Li Qiye said, shocking everyone.

Some thought about Supreme Black Ancestor’s warning but he didn’t reveal further details.

“Hmph, Her Majesty knows more than you do, just hand it over.” An expert coldly uttered.

“I appreciate your kind intent, Young Noble. Even if there is danger with the cicada, we can nullify it.” She said.

“You all are without the slightest clue of what’s truly hidden within. When that time comes, you will pay with your lives.” Li Qiye said.

“Does that mean... you are capable of nullifying it, Young Noble?” She paused in surprise.
